race.comment: WHAT A RIPPER (9) ran below expectations last time at Bendigo, finishing tenth and beaten 9 lengths starting at $6.50. That was a stronger race than this and his two runs prior read well. Can bounce back. BAZZAR (2) resumes from a spell of three months. Has filled a minor placing at each of his three first-up runs and can continue to progress for the Meech/Dabernig combination. MARILYN'S EDGE (6) is racing quite well, a winner two back at Moe then close up at Mildura. Right in the mix again. EDGES DIAMOND (5) Made it three unplaced runs from three starts this time in work when fifth over 1100m at Hamilton eight days ago. Fitter and could sneak a place.
